title: File Handling
goal: fopen modes, formatted aur binary I/O, seek aur error handling se persistent data likhna.
definition: File handling se program ka data disk par permanent hota hai. FILE* stream handle hai; fopen mode decide karta hai read/write/append aur text/binary.
explain: Modes: "r" read (must exist), "w" write (truncate/create), "a" append, "r+"/"w+"/"a+" read+write, "rb"/"wb" binary. Har successful fopen ka fclose zaroori hai.
fprintf/fscanf formatted text, fgets/fputs lines, fgetc/fputc characters, fread/fwrite binary blocks. Return values check karo — fgets NULL, fread count.
fseek(stream, offset, SEEK_SET/CUR/END), ftell current offset, rewind start par. Binary records ke liye fseek se random access.
Errors: fopen NULL, perror() message, errno code. EOF detection: fgetc == EOF aur feof. Writing ke baad fclose/flush se data disk par jaata hai.
analogy: File ek diary hai: fopen diary kholta hai (mode batata hai padhna ya likhna), fprintf usme likhta hai, fseek kisi page par jaata hai, fclose diary band karta hai.
why: Config, logs, records aur databases — sab files se shuru hote hain. Interview me text vs binary aur safe record I/O ka sawaal common hai.

syntax.note: fopen fail ho sakta hai — NULL check.
Binary mode me raw bytes; text mode newline translation kar sakta hai.

topics.title: fopen aur modes
topics.body: Mode galat = data loss: "w" existing file truncate kar deta hai. Append ke liye "a". Text "t" default; binary "b" Windows par zaroori.

topics.title: Formatted aur line I/O
topics.body: fprintf/fscanf text records; fgets safe line read; fputs line write; fgetc/fputc chars. scanf family file par same rules follow karta hai (address, return count).

topics.title: Binary I/O aur seek
topics.body: fread/fwrite size*count return karte hain. fseek/ftell se record index par jump: offset = index * sizeof(Record). Portable binary files ke liye fixed-width types (uint32_t) lo.

topics.title: Error handling
topics.body: fopen NULL, ferror, feof, errno aur perror. Cleanup: har error path par fclose. Temporary file + rename se atomic write.

examples.title: Write aur read text
lines: fopen w mode me file banata/truncate karta hai.
fscanf 2 return karta hai jab dono values milein.

examples.title: Binary records aur fseek
lines: fwrite teen records ek saath likhta hai.
fseek record index 2 par jump karta hai.
fread ek record padhta hai; return count check.

mistakes.why: w mode truncate karta hai aur read allow nahi.
Buffer flush nahi hota, data kho sakta hai, handle leak.

debug.brief: File ka last line do baar print ho raha hai. Reason: EOF check galat. Fix karo.
hints: feof read fail hone ke baad true hota hai.
fgets ke return par loop chalao.
debug.fix: while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) printf("%s", line);

interview.q: Text aur binary mode ka fark?
interview.a: Text mode newline translation kar sakta hai (Windows CRLF) aur Ctrl-Z ko EOF samajh sakta hai; binary mode raw bytes deta hai. Binary records ke liye "b" use karo.
interview.followUp: Portable records? — fixed-width types, endianness document karo.

interview.a: Buffered data flush hota hai, file descriptor free hota hai, aur write errors report hote hain. Leak se descriptors khatam ho jaate hain.
interview.followUp: Crash par buffer? — data lose ho sakta hai; fflush ya atomic rename.
